{{Icon|Heat Susceptibility icon|text=false|nolink=true}} [[Heat Susceptibility]] is a type of debuff inflicted to enemies in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

When enemies are inflicted with '''Heat Susceptibility''', they temporarily take more {{Color|Heat DMG|3}}. The number represents the degree of increase.

Multiple sources of Heat Susceptibility, as well as {{G|Arts Susceptibility}}, stack <u>additively</u> to form the '''Susceptibility Multiplier''' for that DMG instance. The resulting Susceptibility Multiplier then stacks <u>multiplicatively</u> with other damage multipliers to get the final value. For more information on calculating damage, see [[Damage calculation]].
